conversion.reproduction_python:
from pathlib import Path
from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter
from docling.datamodel.base_models import InputFormat
p=Path("publisher-article-body.html")
r=DocumentConverter(allowed_formats=[InputFormat.HTML]).convert(p)
r.document.save_as_markdown(p.with_suffix(".docling.md"))
r.document.save_as_json(p.with_suffix(".docling.json"))
